summary: This note covers the 2017 mayoral election in St. Petersburg, Florida, held November 7, 2017. Incumbent Rick Kriseman, a nonpartisan candidate, defeated Rick Baker, also nonpartisan, winning 34,531 votes (51%) to Baker's 32,341 (49%). The note is a brief infobox-style summary with navigation links to the 2013 and 2021 elections, and it gives no further campaign detail.
one_line: Rick Kriseman narrowly defeated Rick Baker in the nonpartisan November 2017 mayoral election in St. Petersburg, Florida.
